# BalanceState

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/gait.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/gait.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

The kinematic walk's balance, written by GaitBalance each tick: centre of mass, crouch, support, capture.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `valid` | `bool` | written at least once (default false) |
| `com` | `glm::vec3` | centre of mass of the solved pose (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `velocity` | `glm::vec3` | filtered centre of mass velocity (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `xcom` | `glm::vec3` | extrapolated centre of mass on the ground: com + velocity / omega (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `ground` | `float` | height of the ground under the centre of mass (default 0.0) |
| `lead` | `float` | m the extrapolated centre of mass is ahead of the reference point (default 0.0) |
| `error` | `float` | m left between the centre of mass and its target (default 0.0) |
| `iterations` | `int` | pelvis placement iterations this tick (default 0) |
| `crouch` | `float` | m the hips sit under their nominal height (default 0.0) |
| `bias` | `float` | m of that held through the stride, so the hips move smoothly (default 0.0) |
| `deficit` | `float` | the most reach this step lacked so far (default 0.0) |
| `wanted` | `float` | what bias is settling to (default 0.0) |
| `lift` | `float` | m the hips are held up so that the knees do not fold past their stop (scrambling) (default 0.0) |
| `lift_room` | `float` | the least the legs' reach left over the hips in the last step (default 10.0) |
| `lift_room_step` | `float` | the same in this step so far (default 10.0) |
| `offset` | `glm::vec3` | where the hips ended, from where GaitBase put them (default glm::vec3(0.0)) |
| `support` | `std::vector<glm::vec2>` | convex hull of the soles' last and next prints and of the planted palms, x z |
| `outside` | `float` | m the centre of mass is outside it (default 0.0) |
| `lateral_margin` | `float` | m from the extrapolated centre of mass to the stance foot's outer edge (default 0.0) |
| `captured` | `bool` | a heel struck on this tick (default false) |
| `capture_error` | `float` | m along the heading between that heel and xcom - capture_offset (default 0.0) |

## Notes

On the rig entity, emplaced by GaitBalance; read on the next tick by GaitBase, GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK, and by GaitChecks; removed by GaitRoutes at a new route.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: GaitBase, GaitChecks, GaitFootIK, GaitHandIK, GaitView. Written by: GaitBalance. Created by: GaitBalance. Destroyed by: GaitRoutes.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create** | tick | emplaced on first use; crouch, offset, centre of mass, support, capture of this tick |
| [GaitBase](../systems/GaitBase.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | centre of mass height (omega) and the hips' offset of the last tick |
| [GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | centre of mass, capture, support, margins |
| [GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | hips' offset and lead of the extrapolated centre of mass of the last tick |
| [GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md) | system | World | **read** | tick | the hips' offset of the last tick |
| [GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md) | system | World | **destroy** | start | removed from the rig entity |
| [GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick (world registry) | com, xcom, ground, support polygon, errors shown |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[GaitBalance](../systems/GaitBalance.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitBase](../systems/GaitBase.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitChecks](../systems/GaitChecks.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[GaitFootIK](../systems/GaitFootIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities on the first tick of a gait.
- **[GaitHandIK](../systems/GaitHandIK.md)**
  - Creates two IK chain entities and two IK target entities the first time scrambling is on.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
- **[GaitView](../systems/GaitView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Gait" (with "panel").
  - Pooled host marker entities, destroyed in finish.
